headline: Itti Suspends Staff and Faces Fallout From Ueno Bank System Issues
summary: Itti, the technological arm of Grupo Vázquez developing systems for Paraguayan lender Ueno Bank, suspended part of its personnel in Argentina for 30 days without pay amid operational and financial hurdles.
why: Operational disruptions and solvency issues at financial technology providers can trigger sudden labor cutbacks and commercial uncertainty.

impacts.name: Itti
impacts.why: Staff suspensions and cash shortages point to severe near-term operational challenges for the business.
